name: banking77
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which one intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Choose the single most specific matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a newly received card; activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; can children/teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay with the card or to top up; setting them up; they don't work.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, using the card at ATMs in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: turning it on/off, how it works, why it topped up automatically.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.definition: Customer made a bank transfer (into their account) and it is not showing in the balance yet; asks why a transfer they just made has not shown up.
examples: What's the time frame normally for a UK account transfer? I just made one and it's not showing up anywhere. I want to be sure that everything is good.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.definition: Customer deposited money (cash, cheque, or an unspecified deposit) but it is not showing in the balance yet.
examples: I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?

beneficiary_not_allowed.definition: Unable to add a beneficiary/payee, a transfer to a beneficiary/account is not allowed or was not cleared / beneficiary rejected.
examples: I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery.
My account transfer was not cleared.

criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer already made (e.g. sent to the wrong account or by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card; what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; a merchant or shop does not accept the card; can I use the card for X.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery; card still not received.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a new card will arrive in general, express delivery, delivery to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app/account; re-linking a card that was found after being lost.

card_not_working.definition: The card is not working / can't use the card in general, it has not worked at several places, is my card working, card broken or damaged (no single specific declined purchase).
examples: I don't know what's wrong with my card, but it has not worked at multiple places today.

criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a card payment / purchase; extra fee when paying by card.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase in the account that the customer explicitly did not make or does not recognise.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.definition: The exchange rate applied was wrong/incorrect (a card payment/purchase, or an unspecified 'the rate I got is incorrect').
examples: It seems that the rate I got is incorrect.

criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / ate the card.

cash_withdrawal_charge.definition: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; ATM withdrawal fees.
examples: I got charged a fee that shouldn't be there from my cash

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.definition: A cash withdrawal or cash transaction showing on the account/app that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
examples: I think somebody made an unauthorized copy of my card.  My account has a cash withdrawal for 500£ that I did not make.  Please help.
THere is some cash that is showing up on my app.

criteria.change_pin: How to change an existing card PIN to a new one (not getting the first PIN, not blocked).

compromised_card.definition: Card details were stolen/compromised or someone else has access to or is using the card details (fraud concern), even if they mention a purchase made with the stolen details. Exception: an unrecognised cash withdrawal goes to cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.
examples: What can I do if my card details where stolen from my car? I think they used my card to buy gas.

criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments with the card don't work.

country_support.definition: Which countries the service and cards are available in; can I get a card or account if I live outside the UK / in the EU / in another country.
examples: I live in the EU, can I get one of your cards?
I'm not in the UK, but can I still get a card?

declined_card_payment.definition: A specific card payment at a shop or online was declined / rejected; the card did not work at a shop or for a particular purchase.
examples: I could not get my card to work at a shop.

declined_cash_withdrawal.definition: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / couldn't get cash out.
examples: I could not get the ATM to work

declined_transfer.definition: An outgoing transfer was declined / rejected / denied by the bank, or the customer was told the transfer is not possible / cannot make a transfer; complains their transfers keep being denied.
examples: I have tried a couple of times to make a purchase and my card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfers? I have already tried a couple of times and it's not working.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.definition: A direct debit, or an unspecified charge the customer does not know the origin of ('I don't know what this charge is for').
examples: i do not know what this charge is for

criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many times they can be used, how many can be created, restrictions.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details such as name, address, email, phone number on the account.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency or paying in a foreign currency; is there a charge for currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where rates come from, current rates (general questions, not complaints of a wrong rate, not ATM rates).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange / convert money between currencies in the app.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra charge or fee (e.g. an extra £1) appearing on the statement.

failed_transfer.definition: An outgoing transfer or payment failed / got an error / didn't go through / keeps failing despite repeated attempts.
examples: I'm getting an error when trying to make a payment. I want to purchase a flat but my mortgage payment needs to go through. Can you help me?
Why do my transfers keep failing?
I have tried 5 times at this point to complete a transfer that's simply standard. What appears to be the problem? Is your system messed up?

criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held, exchanged or used on the account.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.

get_physical_card.definition: Getting the physical card and its PIN: where to find or how to get a PIN for my card, can't find the PIN, already has a virtual card and wants a plastic one.
examples: I can't find the PIN.
how do i get a pin for my card

getting_spare_card.definition: Getting an additional/spare/second/another card, e.g. ordering another card or a card for a family member; how many cards can I have.
examples: What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?
How do I go about ordering another card?

getting_virtual_card.definition: How to get or order a virtual card; is a virtual card available; cost of a virtual card.
examples: How can I locate the virtual card?

lost_or_stolen_card.definition: The card was lost or stolen; help retrieving / finding my card.
examples: Can you help me retrieve my card?
My card has been stolen. I reported it with the police, but I need to report it with you as well.

criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the app was lost or stolen; accessing the account without the phone.

order_physical_card.definition: How to get/order a card of my own (first card), whether ordering a card costs money, whether cards are shipped/delivered anywhere, delivery address for the card.
examples: Is payment required to get a card of my own?
Where can I get a physical card?
Do you ship your cards anywhere?

criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login password; reset passcode.

pending_card_payment.definition: A card payment/purchase is still pending; when will my payment go through (a generic 'payment' means a card payment).
examples: When will my payment go through?

criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.

pending_top_up.definition: A top-up is pending or doesn't seem to have completed yet; where are the funds from my top-up.
examples: Where are my funds? I topped off my car but it didn't seem to complete.

criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is still pending; why is my transfer pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN/card.

receiving_money.definition: How to receive money, get paid, receive salary or transfers from others into the account.
examples: Do I need to add my salary?

criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the merchant already issued/promised has not appeared in the account yet.

request_refund.definition: Wants to get a refund for a purchase: how to request a refund, whether a refund is possible, how long getting a refund takes.
examples: How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?

reverted_card_payment?.definition: A card payment was reverted / returned / cancelled after being made; money came back unexpectedly.
examples: I just found out from the seller that my money didn't go through. I checked my account and it was deducted at first but now it's back in my account. Can you  please fix this for me quickly?

supported_cards_and_currencies.definition: Which card types and currencies are supported (e.g. for top-ups or payments).
examples: what currencies can i use to add money to my account

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.definition: Topping up / adding money by bank transfer, SWIFT or international transfer into the account and any fee for it.
examples: I want to do a swift transfer

criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque.

top_up_failed.definition: A top-up failed / was declined / the customer is not sure it went through / something went wrong with the top-up so the money is not accessible.
examples: I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly.
I'm not sure if my pop-up went through.

criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum amount, how much or how often can top up.

top_up_reverted.definition: A top-up was reverted / cancelled / money taken back after topping up.
examples: What did you do with my money??? I just topped up, I saw the money was there, but now it's gone!! What did you do with it?

topping_up_by_card.definition: Topping up using a card: how to do it, and problems after a card top-up such as the money being gone after topping up with a card.
examples: I tried topping up using my card, but the money is gone?

criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or payment was charged twice / duplicate charge.

transfer_fee_charged.definition: A fee was charged for a transfer (including when the customer believed transfers were free and sees an unexpected fee).
examples: This isn't fair! I thought transfers could be made for free. I just made  a purchase online from abroad and now see some strange fee that I've never seen before.

transfer_into_account.definition: How to transfer money into the account from another bank; what ways are there to add money to my account.
examples: My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.definition: Money the customer sent (to a friend, retailer, another account) has not been received or has not gone through yet; an in-country transfer made days ago not posted yet.
examples: Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?
Why hasn't my in country transfer gone through yet? I confirmed the account info a couple days ago but the payment hasn't been posted yet.
How long does it take for money to transfer?  I sent some to a friend and it hasn't gone through yet.

transfer_timing.definition: How long a transfer takes to arrive; transfer speed.
examples: It's been a couple days how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?

criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Tried to verify identity but it failed / can't complete identity verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.

verify_source_of_funds.definition: Source of funds / available money: verifying or showing where the money comes from, seeing the source of my available money, can I see my available money.
examples: Can I see my available money?

criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up card, e.g. can't find the verification code for a card top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work / is declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.

examples: Do i have to verify who I am?

criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested, but full amount charged.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.definition: Exchange rate for cash withdrawals: what rate foreign ATMs use, wrong rate applied to an ATM withdrawal abroad, or withdrawing cash in another currency while travelling.
examples: Can I make a withdraw in my home currency at an ATM? I'm on vacation and am a bit worried because I don't have cash with me. Is it possible to withdraw here without any additional costs or fees?
what is the exchange rate for foreign ATMs
